title: Make Night context-aware
summary: Night now reacts to the live duty phase, personal roster changes and the next action that matters, while stronger visual and notification safeguards keep the experience clearer and harder to regress.
changes: Introduces Night Focus during the active duty window, showing current Malta time, the live First Part or Second Part phase, the signed-in nurse’s immediate duty context, automatic handover state changes and one subtle optional handover haptic.

Makes personal roster changes unmistakable with a direct before-to-after alert, a private per-device history of changes affecting the signed-in nurse, assignment-focused notification deep links and a meaningful app badge reserved for unread Chat or unresolved personal change.

Separates notification controls for Changes affecting me and General roster updates, with schema-54 targeted delivery that uses verified roster identity without exposing the affected-name list in notification content.
Upgrades Changes review with an explicit Before versus After diff, plain-language five-nurse and seven-nurse consequences, and one promoted next action instead of competing prompts.

Consolidates Night, Changes and Breaks around one selected-night state model and adds automatic low-light Night mode from midnight to 07:00 while preserving clinical semantic colours and the user’s normal appearance preference.

Adds multi-width layout contracts plus an approved screenshot-regression workflow that compares canonical Night, Changes and Breaks captures against the latest successful main baseline and flags unapproved visual drift.
